name: quick-notes
title: Quick Notes
description: Create simple markdown notes in Raycast and sync to a folder locally. No integrations required!
author: biknandy

commands.name: index
commands.title: View Notes
commands.description: Create, view, and manage your quick notes.

commands.name: manage-tags
commands.title: Manage Tags
commands.description: Create, edit, and delete your tags.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.description: Search notes by title, body, or tag

commands.name: export
commands.title: Export Notes
commands.description: Export all notes to a directory.

commands.name: import-notes
commands.title: Import Notes
commands.description: Import markdown files into your notes.

commands.name: sync
commands.title: Sync with Folder
commands.description: 2-way sync existing markdown files from the auto save directory.

preferences.name: fileLocation
preferences.title: Auto Save Location
preferences.description: Select a folder to save markdown files

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
